title: The queue that resolved on a timeout
blurb: Auto-resolve fired on a timeout for anything above 0.5 confidence.
prompt: A spam wave was silently resolved by the queue itself when the enforcement service timed out, because the draft auto-resolved high-confidence items and treated a timeout as approval. The same draft stranded items when reviewers abandoned leases. Review it, fix it, and prove auto-resolution is a narrow granted class and leases return.
aiNote: The draft auto-resolves on enforcement timeouts for any item above a 0.5 confidence, so an enforcement outage becomes a silent self-approval loop, and it assigns items without leases so a crashed reviewer strands work forever.
testIdea: Time out enforcement and assert the item escalates to a human; abandon a lease and assert the item re-enters the queue; enqueue the same source twice and assert one item.
followUps: Which categories are ever safe to auto-resolve?
How do you keep SLA clocks honest across regions?
What would you record to audit an auto-resolve months later?
